# Kenney Skater Male

Model and original skin by Kenney, Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0).
[Official Protagonists pack](https://kenney.nl/assets/animated-characters-protagonists).
The model comes from Kenney’s [Animated Characters 2 upload on OpenGameArt](https://opengameart.org/content/animated-characters-2),
which includes `Model/characterMedium.fbx`, `Skins/skaterMaleA.png`, and three animations (`idle`, `jump`, `run`).

`skater-ciac.glb` is the converted model with an adapted clothing texture, UVs, and a folded hood weighted to the upper chest. Its original
deform skeleton and weights drive the mesh. Surfer CIAC transfers the original Mixamo animation
poses onto this skeleton, including clips that the Kenney pack does not supply.
